publishers.source_authority_limit: Original, migrated, related/successor and third-party custody are distinct. No aliases, reader qualification or publication follow from this inventory.

access_failures.issuu: Publisher-linked 112th, 112th first-session and 113th document URLs returned 404 bodies. Profile also returned 404. These outcomes do not prove deletion everywhere.
access_failures.archive: 112th Issuu availability queries returned empty archived_snapshots for inspected variants; 113th availability failed with RetryableHTTPStatusError. Direct 2017 catalog fetch failed; Zyte recovered its body.
access_failures.reader_metadata: Inferred reader3.isu.pub metadata URLs returned CredentialRefusedError; one Zyte attempt returned ZyteTransportError. No metadata or page images recovered.
access_failures.http_failure_limit: Where the capture library raised before returning a response, the manifest records the exception type but no HTTP status or body; do not invent a 401/403 or treat it as source absence.

rights.basis: Archived ASCF pages contain an All Rights Reserved notice. Public retrieval or archival hosting does not grant a reuse license. No outreach or rights decision performed.

inspection_limits.stop_reason: Human wrap-up instruction; no new investigations, probes, downloads, implementation or backfill after instruction. No request remained running.
inspection_limits.transport: Existing SpicyDocs BoundedHttpCapture and credential-safe ZyteHttpFetcher, called by capture.py; no credential values retained.
inspection_limits.search: Bounded publisher/title/date and archive queries; search results used as leads. Not exhaustive; search-tool requests are separate from the retained capture-attempt count.
inspection_limits.archive_index_limit: The successful broad CDX query was capped at 100 records; failed alternative queries and availability responses do not establish absence.
inspection_limits.pdf_work: Small native-text and rendered-page inspections; no bulk OCR, model extraction, production reader, complete table extraction, gate or native generation.
inspection_limits.pre_2000: Catalog and source identification only. CIA PDF retained whole (104 pages); native-text discovery found no text; low-resolution contact sheet covered pages 1–24 and pages 20–21 were visually reviewed. No pre-2000 table corpus extracted.

publishers.review_limit: Existing reports/results read directly. Selected retained response bytes/metadata checked for syntax, file shape and declared fields; full member/item/model observations remain private and are not independently qualified here.

publishers.finding: Brown item JSON, IIIF manifests, ALTO/OCR and document streams support archive delivery. No attributable current ACA rating API or complete score export was established.
